name: find-github-tool
description: Find the right open-source tool, app, library, add-on or AI model for any need, in plain language.
long_description: Searches GitHub plus 15+ other sources (app stores, self-hosting catalogs, package registries, curated lists, community discussion), checks maintenance health, setup difficulty and license, and helps Claude explain the best picks in plain words. Use the find-github-tool prompt to start.

github_token.title: GitHub token (optional)
github_token.description: A GitHub personal access token with no scopes. Raises GitHub limits from 60 to 5,000 calls/hour. Leave empty to use it without one.
